python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
review='''Reviewed the complete contributor diff and the additive maintainer follow-up at 4a6c09ec82e458c265837d7c5e50b5b9752848c4.

The original draft/focus fix is useful and appropriately scoped. I independently reproduced the original browser smoke and unit results: 148 passed, 2 platform skips, no failures. Scope review found no new dependencies, credential access, external network destinations, installer changes, or executable payloads in the contribution. This is a scoped review, not a repository-wide security certification.

I added a signed-off follow-up for two edge cases found during review: preserve the selected outcome with its summary, and prevent an earlier save response from clearing newly edited/reopened/other-task/other-project drafts. It also retains selection direction. The original contributor commit is preserved.

The final combined browser smoke passes, including 14 additional cases covering draft text, focus/caret/scroll, literal markup, delayed successful saves, failed saves and task/project/dialog isolation. Syntax and formatting checks pass. Replaying these cases against the original contributor UI reproduces the failures; the final UI passes. Evidence is in docs/reviews/2026-10-29-pr5.json. Firefox, Safari and screen readers were not tested.

Approved for merge. Finding 2 remains a separate follow-up as agreed. Thank you for the careful audit and contribution!'''
Path('/tmp/dip-pr5-approval.json').write_text(json.dumps({'commit_id':'4a6c09ec82e458c265837d7c5e50b5b9752848c4','event':'APPROVE','body':review}))
PY
